### Notes

The page lists four eligibility criteria: fewer than 20 employees, no existing Apollo subscription, a valid company domain, and affiliation with one of Apollo's startup ecosystem partners. The partner requirement reads as soft rather than hard: the page adds that if your startup isn't connected to a partner you can still apply and Apollo will provide guidance. employees_max is recorded as 20 but the page's exact wording is "Fewer than 20 employees". Percentage discount is published; no dollar cap is published by Apollo itself. Eligibility quoted verbatim: "your company should have fewer than 20 employees, no existing Apollo subscription, a valid company domain, and an affiliation with one of our startup ecosystem partners". Unaffiliated startups may still apply and be connected with next steps. No funding limit is published.
